source_label: PIML hourly simulation · 148.2 mm RIDF design storm (NOAH-calibrated)
description: Hourly 24-hr 25yr design storm simulated by the PIML surrogate from the official DOST-NOAH / UP DREAM Lumbia RIDF hyetograph (148.2 mm total, 34.2 mm peak-hour) on 10m LiDAR topography.
